paper.title: Dynamics of social balance on networks

headline: AKR 2005 CTD / Heider balance (signed-network dynamics): 3/3 locked clauses REPRO; 10/10 seeds reach balance (0 paradise, 10 two-faction); frustration monotone non-increasing

verdicts.gate: P1 reaches balance: fraction of seeds reaching a balanced absorbing state (energy 0) >= 0.90
P2 valid <=2-faction balance: every final state partitions into all-positive paradise OR two factions (+ intra / - inter), verified
P3 frustration non-increasing: the imbalanced-triangle count never rises under the dynamics (every seed's energy series monotone non-increasing)

extra.framing: signed-network dynamics (model-orchestrated triad/edge updates), NOT autonomous agent-stepping
extra.scope: faithful reproduction of a published synthetic model; no real-world data; the contribution is whether the harness + discipline reproduce the AKR drive to structural balance (absorbing <=2-faction state, monotone-decreasing frustration) and would catch an artifact

citations: Antal, T., Krapivsky, P.L. & Redner, S. (2005). Dynamics of social balance on networks. Phys. Rev. E 72(3):036121. doi:10.1103/PhysRevE.72.036121.
Heider, F. (1946). Attitudes and cognitive organization. J. Psychology 21:107-112.

benchmark.note: no cross-tool baseline; faithful single-implementation reproduction graded against reaching a balanced absorbing state, its valid <=2-faction structure, and monotone-non-increasing frustration
